info.title: EPP Capture API
info.description: PostgreSQL records belonging to the authenticated session user. Errors use Problem Details. Capture creation is not idempotent; candidate acceptance supports operation identity.

post.summary: Use a verified email or existing user ID and password to create a session
post.description: A new random token is set only in an HttpOnly SameSite=Strict cookie. The database stores its SHA-256 digest. Absolute lifetime 8 hours; maximum 20 sessions per user. Labels are user supplied, not verified device identities. JSON only; no query parameters. Wrong and absent credentials share 401. Public origins require HTTPS. A lost response can leave an unused session; inspect the session list after signing in again.

get.description: One item per learning record. Default limit 20, maximum 100; order by createdAt descending then UUID descending. Optional expressionId filters before limiting. Unknown or foreign expression filters return an empty list. No mode preserves the original response. mode=offset accepts offset 0..10000 and adds nextOffset (null at end or cap); mode=cursor adds nextCursor (null at end). Continuations bind resource, user, limit, expressionId, from and to. Invalid, changed-scope or expired cursors return 400 INVALID_CURSOR; traversal expires after 30 minutes. from inclusive / to exclusive require UTC ISO milliseconds in years 0001..9999, with from strictly before to, and filter learning creation time. Both modes read live data, not a snapshot. Unknown and repeated query keys are rejected. No userId parameter; ownership comes from the session.

No semantic edges, ranking, coordinates or full-graph claim.

post.description: Requires a lowercase UUID operationId and no query. Save it before the first send and reuse it for every retry of this exact candidate. Successful operations are scoped to the current user and retained without automatic expiry. Same identity and fingerprint replay the original 201 JSON; changed candidate returns OPERATION_CONFLICT. Failed attempts are not retained. Different operation identities on an accepted candidate return CANDIDATE_CONFLICT. Historical successes without receipts are not replayable. Business writes and the response snapshot commit in one transaction. Lock wait is limited to 1 second per acquisition; only P2034 is retried internally, at most 3 attempts. Within the current user, exact normalized English and meaning reuse an expression; normalization v1 uses NFC, ASCII whitespace folding and ASCII case folding. Each accepted candidate keeps its own learning record and source. Existing expression display text is preserved. No AI or similarity matching. On timeout or an unknown outcome, retry with the same identity and content after bounded backoff
